summary: Owned units s0111–s0132 contain one explicit calendar date: the Lanting preface opening 永和九年，歲在癸丑，暮春之初. That date is Eastern Jin Emperor Mu’s Yonghe 9, cyclical guichou, conventionally AD 353; late spring / the third lunar month of that year remains inside AD 353 and does not cross the Gregorian New Year. Academia Sinica’s converter defaults to Julian before 1582-10-15, but a year-precision Western label is unaffected. Claims 212 and 219 correctly assign that year to Wang Xizhi’s own gathering and preface and do not invent a numbered month/day the chapter never writes. Xie An’s Kuaiji residence before office, the four eastern-land houses of Sun Chuo, Li Chong, Xu Xun and Zhi Dun, the goose-widow anecdote, and the later undated Wang anecdotes are all without a source year; empty active hints match that evidence. Peng Zu, Pan Yue and Shi Chong appear only as later reception, not as living activity, and must not feed life dates. Claim 964 omits the reception date of the Peng Zu allusion, which stands inside the dated preface: that year belongs on the retrospective event, not in hints-p036. No owned unit states a birth, death or countable age for an owned person; 殤 in 齊彭殤 is a generic short-lived child, not a named death.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi is attested by the Orchid Pavilion preface he himself wrote, which opens with the Yonghe 9 late-spring date.
itemChecks.reason: The dated event belongs to Wang Xizhi (p028), the preface’s author in s0114. s0115 names 永和九年, 歲在癸丑, 暮春之初: Eastern Jin (東晉), Emperor Mu (晉穆帝), era Yonghe, year 9, cyclical guichou. A reign table equates that year with AD 353, and 暮春 (third lunar month) of Yonghe 9 falls in the fourth Julian month of 353, so the Western year does not flip. Year precision is right: the chapter never writes 三月三日, and a reign-year-plus-season label is not a Gregorian day. Academia Sinica’s pre-1582 Julian default would matter for a day conversion, not for this year endpoint.

itemChecks.event: Wang Xizhi banqueted at the Orchid Pavilion in Shanyin and composed the preface dated Yonghe 9.
itemChecks.reason: Owner of the event is Wang Xizhi (p028): s0114 has him banquet at 會稽山陰之蘭亭 and write the preface; s0115 dates that meeting. The AD 353 year endpoint is the conventional Western equivalent of 永和九年 / 癸丑 under Emperor Mu of Eastern Jin. 暮春之初 keeps the gathering inside AD 353; no second endpoint is warranted. The chapter’s 修禊 and 暮春之初 are retained as Chinese season/rite wording, not upgraded to an inferred 三月三日 Gregorian date.
